      <div class="page-content">
        <p>
          Committee membership is being reviewed with the AFRICON Steering
          Committee to broaden international IEEE Region 8 representation,
          particularly on the Technical Program Committee. IEEE grades are
          retained where confirmed. Institutional affiliations and countries
          marked as pending will be replaced after the member verifies them.
        </p>

            </li>
